title: Change ending text from 'always dithering and slytherin' to 'ravenclaw and slytherin for life'

requirements.text: In the MainCard component (frontend/src/App.tsx), find the ending text that currently reads 'always dithering and slytherin' and replace it with the exact text: 'ravenclaw and slytherin for life'. The new text must be styled consistently with the existing Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme and typography.

quotes: At the end instead of always dithering and slytherin change it to ravenclaw and slytherin for life

acceptanceCriteria: The text 'always dithering and slytherin' no longer appears anywhere in the rendered UI.
The text 'ravenclaw and slytherin for life' appears at the end of the main page message in its place.
The new text is styled consistently with the existing Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme and typography.
No other text or layout is changed.

constraints: Do not change any other text or messaging outside of the specific 'always dithering and slytherin' line.
Do not add or remove the 🥺 emoji.
Do not modify any immutable frontend paths.
nonGoals: Changing the visual theme or color palette.
